fusions.name: Took My Time
fusions.desc: Takes 2 seconds to aim, then fires a shot that deals 40 damage to the first enemy it meets. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Muzzle Flash
fusions.desc: A blast of smoke and sparks that deals 10 damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead, stuns each one for 1 second and leaves it [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Fuse
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to set a charge at the nearest enemy. It arms after 3 seconds and waits up to 12 seconds; the first enemy within 2 tiles sets it off, and it deals 24 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Waited for the Shot
fusions.desc: When you have gone a while without a critical hit, your critical chance rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
